headline: DEFENDER patrol stops flying into divers
lede: Stage 4 of the survival arc read the killing ticks themselves and found one geometric hole left in the pilot: divers that come straight down the package's column, where the horizontal laser cannot reach. The patrol now breaks the column at full cruise and its brace hop covers the whole kill box — honest lives spent across the audit drops 46 to 36.

notes.text: #3456 is complete: the survival claim (20/20 + 20/20) held through all four stages, and the honest floors moved with it — diedHauling pin tightened 8 to 4, banks min 43,500 + 35,850.

watchmeasure learned --autopsy: it dumps position, velocity, killer approach and the route's own presses at every death — the table that found the overhead pocket (|bx|<18, kvy ±2–3) and will keep future deaths nameable.

Two candidates rejected by measurement, not taste: hopping away-from-hunter unconditionally (holdout deliveries fell under the floor) and a max-rise canyon rule (lives 36 to 48). The mid-horizon ridge gap is filed honestly as #3497 for the QA lane.

defenderplay bomb legs recalibrated: presses during death windows are honestly suppressed, so legs that read on fixed 120 ms waits were coin-flips — they now seat the patrol, gate on a healthy pilot, and settle for the edge. Chrome drive 17/17 twice.
